scope: same final144main runs as27D; no smoke/failed-attempt duplication; unchanged prior classifications
pairing: all handovers retained; paired run=phase,scene,seed; event pairs additionally same trigger A/B and evaluation physical target, chronological occurrence; unmatched rows retained; not identical-state counterfactuals
target: B-trigger component occupied cells mapped to nearest oracle surface by majority; component IDs only comparable within run. No component => UNKNOWN, not force paired
distance: body clearance: exact signed point/segment distance minus recorded circular robot radius; boxes and walls separate plus overall minimum
path: actual installed detour path, evaluated against obstacles active at application; also evaluate at handover if another box appeared
endpoint: terminal chord heading vs reference tangent at endpoint; actual handover yaw error also retained. Speed=actual at handover plus stored SP terminal profile value
retrigger: new R3 TRIGGER in (handover,handover+10s]; follow-up capped at run end; R2-only attempts separately counted; same_component requires same within-run ID, physical-target agreement separate
native_direction: first logged native FRESH strictly after handover; pure FRESHEST over all8 remaining lengths, low-index tie; angle vs outgoing detour chord >90deg reverses, <=90 continues; no direction=>undefined; deferred flag retained
terminal: all unsuccessful runs; min true-goal distance<=0.6m; last20s or entire shorter run, actual measured poses/speeds
goal_candidates: all8 endpoint fraction, any endpoint, and raw FRESHEST endpoint inside recorded goal tolerance; latest saved FRESH held forward at72Hz, validity flagged
states: C0/baselines: logged SP mode/target/source; SP slowing=GO and target<0.3. G has graph-speed executor, so SP=N/A; graph rotations reported separately. ALL_UNSAFE is not always path rejection in G
decision: qualitative mechanism diagnosis, not a newly tuned numerical gate; separate phase/outcome strata and matched-run evidence required; UNCLEAR if competing/confounded/weak
cautions: B4 R2 is A* in21/24R/R2 but SLSQP in26; G executor differs; event reuse and incomplete10s are explicit; no causal proof from observational logs
